designGate.method: one keyframe per genre through the candidate prompts → the strict VLM genre check (z-ai vision) BEFORE freezing
designGate.verdict:
A) YES. The core composition of the player kicking the ball, the defender in blue, and the background player is preserved across all four images.
B) YES. It successfully adopts a top-down schematic style with flat vector graphics, a tactical grid, and a data legend, completely abandoning photorealism.
C) YES. It features characteristic 3D rendering traits like low-poly geometry, uniform lighting, hard-edged shadows, and a "plastic" game-engine aesthetic.
D) YES. It displays clear hand-drawn qualities including ink outlines, cel-shaded color blocks, stylized proportions, and a lack of photographic texture.
E) None; all three stylized images (2, 3, and 4) successfully pass their respective genre tests.

videoLevelCheck.method: three sampled frames per genre (early/middle/late) + the original frame — ten images, one strict VLM call: same-scene in all ten + every genre frame actual to its genre
videoLevelCheck.verdict:
A) YES, the core scene (player in red vest vs blue, specific pitch markings and background structures) is consistently identifiable across all ten images.
B) YES, all three frames utilize flat vector graphics, grid overlays, and abstracted player markers consistent with a tactical board aesthetic.
C) YES, all three frames display 3D game-engine rendering with realistic textures, lighting, and shadows typical of a sports simulation game.
D) YES, all three frames exhibit distinct hand-drawn line art, cel-shaded coloring, and stylized features characteristic of anime.
E) YES, each video maintains a high level of stylistic consistency and clearly embodies its assigned genre.

Keep the exact same camera framing, every player's position and pose, the ball and the pitch layout identical — same scene, same moment, only the rendering becomes a tactical analysis board.
frozen.three-d-game: Redraw this exact soccer frame as a modern 3D video game graphic: the players and pitch rendered as clean cel-shaded 3D models like a current-gen console sports game (FIFA / eFootball style), smooth low-poly geometry, crisp bright textures, clean stadium lighting, a slight game-engine sheen. Keep the exact same camera framing, every player's position and pose, the ball and the pitch layout identical — same scene, same moment, only the render becomes a 3D game engine frame.
frozen.anime-npr: Redraw this exact soccer frame as genuine hand-drawn Japanese anime artwork: clean bold ink line art, flat cel shading with hard shadow edges, a bright anime color palette, the painted-background style of a TV anime episode, simplified stylized features. Keep the exact same camera framing, every player's position and pose, the ball and the pitch layout identical — same scene, same moment, only the art style becomes real anime.
